chat.welcomeMessage: Dispatch & reporting demo for Port Operations (sample work data on public map layers). The AI chat replays a recorded session: pick the questions below in order to see it query and navigate the map, color features, measure distances, build report cards and export a PDF / CSV. Also try the Reports tab (run a report from the library, download its PDF / CSV, compare versions), History (two earlier chats), and the map tools on the left (search, layers, select, measure).

insights.title: Reports
insights.emptyMessage: Reports appear here: ask the chat for a chart, table or KPIs, or run a report from the library.

demo.note: Demo: map layers are public data; work activities, people and capital projects are sample data; the AI chat replays a recorded session of the live app; reports and PDF / CSV files were made by the live report service.
